title: d48a3cfd/T1: Classical blocked gemm + eager operator overloads
description:
First task of story `d48a3cfd`. Delivers classical blocked matrix multiplication with delayed reduction, plus all eager operator overloads on `FieldMatrix<F>`.

## Deliverables

- **Classical blocked `gemm`** over `F: FiniteField`, using `FieldVec::dot_product` as the inner kernel so SIMD is inherited from `0fb99491`.
- **Bounds-aware reduction scheduling** via `FiniteField::Wide` and `max_unreduced_additions()` — `debug_assert!` invariants at each accumulation boundary.
- **All four owned/ref combinations** of `Mul`, `Add`, `Sub` per the `BitMatrix` precedent.
- **`Neg` for unary minus.**
- **Scalar multiplication** `F * &M` and `&M * F`.
- **`Index<(usize, usize)>`** for read access.
- **Criterion micro-bench** for `gemm` at n = 64, 256, 1024 on GF(2^31-1) and GF(2^8).

## Non-goals (deferred to T2/T3)

- Proxy types / expression-template fusion — **T2**.
- Strassen–Winograd recursion — **T3**.

## Success criteria

- [hard] `gemm` correct across GF(7), GF(65521), GF(2^31-1), GF(2^8), GF(2^16); cross-checked against naive triple-loop on small sizes + property-based associativity/distributivity tests.
- [hard] Operators eagerly allocate their result; no proxy types yet.
- [hard] Delayed-reduction kmax invariants asserted in debug builds.
- [hard] All four owned/ref combos + Neg + scalar mul + indexing all work.
- [hard] Criterion bench exists and runs.

## Depends on

- `ab791e27` (dense `FieldMatrix` type).
